groundzero.info.battery: Holds 50,000 FE. Charge it in the Battery Charger; later gear (Geiger counter, guns) runs on it.
groundzero.info.battery_charger: Charges a battery (or any other mod's chargeable item) at up to 512 FE a tick from the power its cables bring, then moves it to the output slot.
groundzero.info.canning_machine: Fills canisters and empties them again. Put an empty canister (liquids) or gas canister (gases) in and it takes 1,000 mB from the supply tank (left) to fill it; put a filled canister in and its 1,000 mB is poured into the catch tank (right). Pipes and buckets fill the supply tank; pipes, buckets and auto-eject drain the catch tank.
groundzero.info.capacitor_bank: Stores power: 100,000 / 1,000,000 / 10,000,000 FE, moving 1,024 / 8,192 / 32,768 FE a tick. Every face takes power in except the front, which pushes it out (turn it with the Wrench). It keeps its charge when picked up, and a comparator reads how full it is. The Creative Capacitor Bank (creative menu only) is always full and pushes up to 1,000,000 FE a tick.
groundzero.info.chemical_plant: Chemical Plant (2x2x2): put the controller down, then add an Energy Port beside it, a Fluid Port behind it, an Item Port in the far corner of that bottom layer, and four Reactor Glass on top. Right-click the controller, or hold a Holo-Projector, to see where each block goes (sneak-right-click opens it before it is finished). The controller itself connects to nothing: power goes into the Energy Port, items in and out through the Item Port, and fluids in and out through the Fluid Port (a Water Pump supplies water). Right-click with a bucket or canister to pour it in, sneak-right-click with an empty one to draw off the product.
groundzero.info.circuit_fabricator: Makes basic, advanced, military and quantum circuits, sensor arrays and superconducting coils. Coils need liquid nitrogen: pipe it into the coolant tank from a Cryogenic Condenser, or pour in a canister.
groundzero.info.creative_fluid_tank: Creative only. Pour a bucket or canister of any fluid in and the tank holds an endless supply of it: buckets, canisters and pipes can draw from it forever. Pouring in a different fluid switches it over; sneak-right-click with an empty hand to clear it.
groundzero.info.decontamination_shower: A walk-in booth: pipe water in and power it, then step inside. It sprays whoever stands in it (20 FE and 10 mB of water a tick), putting out fire and washing off poison, wither and nausea. Radiation contamination will wash off too once radiation exists.
groundzero.info.die: Goes in the Industrial Press die slot and picks what the press makes. Dies are never used up.
groundzero.info.diesel_generator: Burns liquid fuel piped into its tank (or poured in from a canister) for 180 FE a tick: synthetic fuel gives 90 FE per mB, liquid rocket fuel 140; other mods' diesel works too. It pushes power out of its energy faces and pauses when its buffer is full.
groundzero.info.exotic_matter_fabricator: Holds exotic matter in a spinning magnetic cage to make stabilised exotic matter, containment cells and singularity seeds. It draws 400 FE a tick, more than copper cable carries: feed it with insulated or high-voltage cable.
groundzero.info.fission_reactor: Fission Reactor (3x3x4): lead-lined casing round an empty two-block core with reactor glass on all four sides; the controller at the front of the bottom layer and a Fluid Port at the back of it; on top an Item Port, an Energy Port in the middle and a second Item Port. Right-click the controller or hold a Holo-Projector to see where each block goes. The controller itself connects to nothing: pipe coolant into the Fluid Port, feed rods through the Item Ports and take power from the Energy Port. Load uranium fuel rods and withdraw the control rods: up to 1,200 FE a tick. More power means more heat: with water coolant the core runs hotter the further the rods are out and past about 70% it climbs past 900 C and goes critical (SCRAM it, or it melts down at 1,400 C); heavy water (Chemical Plant: deuterium and liquid oxygen) keeps it below that even at full power and lasts five times longer. Without coolant the core heats up fast. Target rods in the breeding slots come out irradiated: DU rods for plutonium, lithium-6 rods for tritium (reprocess them in the Chemical Plant).
groundzero.info.fluid_pipe: Fluid pipes carry what machines push out of faces with auto-eject and fluids switched on, and what pipe sides set to Pull (with the Wrench) draw out of tanks and machines, sharing it between every tank on the run's normal sides. Pipes hold nothing themselves, so breaking one never spills. A run carries as much as its weakest pipe: copper 150, steel 600, pressurized 2,400 mB per tick.
groundzero.info.fluid_tank: Each Fluid Tank holds 16,000 mB. Touching tanks join into one when together they fill a box with a square base up to 3x3 and up to 5 high (720,000 mB). Fluid only moves in and out by pipe: pipes fill it from any side, and a pipe set to pull (with the Wrench) empties it.
groundzero.info.fluids: Chemical fluids live in machine tanks, pipes, canisters and (liquids only) buckets. Spilled acids burn, napalm ignites and liquid oxygen or nitrogen freeze anything standing in them.
groundzero.info.fusion_fuel_synthesizer: Presses lithium-6 dust with deuterium gas (piped in from an Electrolytic Separator) into lithium deuteride pellets, the fuel of thermonuclear weapons.
groundzero.info.fusion_reactor: Fusion Reactor (9x9x3 octagonal ring, the Particle Accelerator's footprint): a base ring of machine casing with the controller at the front centre, a Fluid Port in the middle of the right side and an Energy Port at the back; a ring of toroidal field coils above it with reactor glass viewports in the middle of each side; a ring of vacuum vessel casing on top; and a central solenoid column three blocks tall in the middle. Pipe deuterium, tritium and liquid nitrogen into the Fluid Port. To light the plasma it needs an ignition charge of 2,000,000 FE through its Energy Port (a big capacitor bank); once lit it makes 6,000 FE a tick and pushes it out of the same port. Liquid nitrogen keeps its magnets cold (2 mB a tick): if the nitrogen or the fuel runs out the plasma goes out and must be lit again.
groundzero.info.gas_centrifuge: Pipe uranium hexafluoride gas from the Chemical Plant into the Gas Centrifuge to get enriched uranium nuggets and depleted uranium dust. Cascade: centrifuges joined flange to flange (the pipe flanges on their sides meeting, all facing the same way or the opposite way) run 15% faster for every other centrifuge in the line, counting up to 8 (+105%). The screen shows the cascade size.
groundzero.info.item_pipe: Item pipes carry items between inventories. A pipe side set to Pull (with the Wrench) draws items out of the chest or machine it touches (a machine only gives from its outputs); machines with auto-eject, and hoppers, can push in too. The run hands everything straight to the inventories on its other sides, shared in turn, never back where it came from. Pipes hold nothing, so breaking one never drops items. A run moves as many items as its weakest pipe: iron 8, steel 32, pneumatic 128 items a second (a hopper moves 2.5).
groundzero.info.membrane: Goes in the Cryogenic Condenser's membrane slot and picks which gas it liquefies. Membranes are never used up.
groundzero.info.particle_accelerator: Particle Accelerator (9x9 octagonal ring, two layers): an octagon one block wide, three blocks straight on each side with a five-block staircase at each corner. Bottom layer Steel Plating; top layer Accelerator Magnet Segments with the controller at the front centre, the Injector beside it, the Target Chamber at the back centre, an Energy Port in the middle of one side and an Item Port in the middle of the other. Right-click the controller or hold a Holo-Projector to see where each block goes. It fills a containment cell with antimatter at 2,000 FE a tick. The controller itself connects to nothing: feed power into the Energy Port (insulated cable carries 1,024 FE a tick per run) and containment cells into the Item Port, which also gives out the antimatter cells.
groundzero.info.rtg: A steady 40 FE a tick from a radioisotope slug. An enriched uranium ingot lasts two in-game days (plutonium, from the Fission Reactor, will last ten). The slug decays whether the power is used or not, so wire it to something that always draws.
groundzero.info.sides: Every machine has a side-configuration tab (the wrench on the right of its screen): choose which faces accept items, give out products and connect to power, and switch on auto-eject. Multiblock structures have no tab: they connect only through their Item, Fluid and Energy Ports.
groundzero.info.singularity_reactor: Singularity Reactor (5x5x5): a machine casing floor and roof, steel plating posts at the corners, reactor glass walls, a containment emitter in the middle of each wall and of the roof, and a core cradle floating in the centre of the empty chamber. The controller is in the middle of the front of the floor, an Item Port on the left and an Energy Port on the right; any other floor block can be swapped for an extra Item Port to feed it faster. Put a singularity seed in the controller (it stays there, like a battery in the charger) and charge the cage with 500,000 FE through the Energy Port: the cage engages and holds the seed. Then it eats the items in its feed slots, any item at all. Every item is worth 10,000 FE and it eats at most 50 items a second, so its output is set by how fast you feed it: 10 items a second gives 5,000 FE a tick, 50 a second gives the full 25,000. Holding the cage costs 1,000 FE a tick, the worth of 2 items a second, and it keeps a 500,000 FE reserve for that. Take the seed out to shut it down safely. If the cage runs out of power, or the structure is broken while it holds the seed, the singularity collapses and the seed is destroyed.
groundzero.info.water_pump: Place on a water source block and power it: it draws 50 mB of water a tick (the source is never used up) and pushes it out of its two side outlets into pipes, tanks and machines.
groundzero.info.wrench: Right-click a side of a fluid pipe to cycle it: Normal (fluid travels both ways), Pull (draws fluid out of the tank or machine it touches; shown by a striped collar), Disconnected. Right-click a cable side to connect or disconnect it. Right-click a machine to turn it. Sneak-right-click a pipe, cable, machine, tank or structure block to pick it up.
